# Copilot Instructions

## Source-of-Truth Hierarchy

1. **`openspec/specs/`** -- living requirements; always read before changing behaviour
2. **`data/`** -- authoritative algorithm and category data
3. **`awesome_bioinfo/`** -- implementation that must match specs
4. **`mkdocs/`** -- public docs surface (MkDocs Material); only authoritative docs location

## Generated Outputs -- Do Not Hand-Edit

| File/Dir | Generated by |
|---|---|
| `README.md` | `python -m awesome_bioinfo generate` |
| `mkdocs/docs/` | `python -m awesome_bioinfo mkdocs` |

After changing `data/` or templates, regenerate and verify no unintended drift:

```bash
python -m awesome_bioinfo generate && python -m awesome_bioinfo mkdocs
git diff --exit-code -- README.md mkdocs/docs/
```

**`README.zh-CN.md` is manually maintained -- never treat it as generated or overwrite it.**

## When to Use OpenSpec vs Direct Edit

| Situation | Action |
|---|---|
| Typo, URL fix, add one algorithm entry | Direct edit; no proposal needed |
| New CLI command, validation rule change, multi-module refactor | `/opsx:propose` -> `/opsx:apply` -> `/opsx:archive` |
| Any change touching multiple specs | `/opsx:propose` -> `/opsx:apply` -> `/opsx:archive` |
| Spec drift fix (code already merged) | Direct edit to spec only |

Invoke `/review` before merging if the change touches Python in `awesome_bioinfo/` or any spec in `openspec/specs/`.

## Key Commands

```bash
python -m awesome_bioinfo validate          # must pass before any data PR
python -m awesome_bioinfo stats
python -m awesome_bioinfo search <query>
python -m awesome_bioinfo info <id>
python -m awesome_bioinfo compare <id1> <id2>
python -m awesome_bioinfo export --format json
python -m awesome_bioinfo check-links

ruff check awesome_bioinfo tests && mypy awesome_bioinfo --ignore-missing-imports
pytest tests/ -v --tb=short
```

## Path-Specific Cautions

- **`data/algorithms/*.yaml`** -- one file per category; `id` must be globally unique, lowercase-hyphenated; `description` 50-500 chars; run `validate` after every change
- **`data/categories.yaml`** -- adding/removing a category is a spec-level change; use `/opsx:propose`
- **`templates/`** -- changes here affect all generated output; regenerate and diff before committing
- **`README.zh-CN.md`** -- hand-maintained bilingual file; do not auto-overwrite
- **`scripts/`** -- deprecated; use `python -m awesome_bioinfo` instead
- **`docs/`** -- removed; MkDocs under `mkdocs/` is the only docs surface
